{{Quote|Ladies and gentlemen: the monstrous; the fearsome; Wicket!|Masher, before revealing Wicket Wystri Warrick to a crowd and frightening the mimph's caretaker|<ref name="Mimphs" />}}
A '''mimph''' with [[Color/Legends|pink]] and pale [[Hair/Legends|fur]] lived in a [[Mimph village|village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="Mimphs" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM|quote=The 3 ABY dating (technically, it should be 3.5) is from the timeline in Behind the Magic.}}</ref> the [[mimph]] was still an [[Youngling/Legends|infant]], and was cared for by an [[Unidentified mimph (hat)|older mimph]] of the same [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Mimphs" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="date" /> a [[Hunting/Legends|hunting]] team led by the mimph [[Masher]] captured the young [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and tied him behind a curtain in the [[City/Legends|village]]. The older mimph was carrying the infant when the curtain was drawn and Warrick, much larger than the mimphs, was revealed. The infant's [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which were white with black pupils, were covered by the frightened older mimph's [[Limb/Legends|hand]].<ref name="Mimphs" />

==Behind the scenes==
The infant mimph appeared in "[[Gone With the Mimphs]],"<ref name="Mimphs" /> the ninth episode of the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series, which first aired on [[October 18]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}.</ref>
